# CANDIDATE: INSIDE_DAY_BREAKOUT_VOLUME_RSI

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An inside day reflects volatility contraction; a breakout on above-average volume with RSI extension signals the start of a directional move. The edge exists because inside days often precede explosive moves when volume and momentum confirm the breakout, filtering out false breakouts in low-volume environments.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If today's high ≤ yesterday's high AND today's low ≥ yesterday's low (inside day) AND price breaks above yesterday's high with volume > 1.5×average volume of last 20 bars AND RSI(14) > 60 THEN go long at breakout bar close; OR if price breaks below yesterday's low with volume > 1.5×average volume AND RSI(14) < 40 THEN go short at breakout bar close. Exit shape: Stop = opposite side of the inside day (for longs, stop = inside day low; for shorts, stop = inside day high); target = 2×ATR(14) from entry; optionally trail with chandelier exit after 1×ATR profit. Regime hint: Effective in low‑to‑moderate VIX (12‑22) and during the first two hours of the session when volume spikes are meaningful; avoid periods of major news where volume spikes are noise.
